integrity: The proof establishes infinite-parameter claims analytically. Computations corroborate selected finite orders and are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for three distinct erasures and the equal-weight three-frequency family {0,1,m} on even order 2m, m>=3; not a result for arbitrary frequency bands, erasure counts or weights. Numerical tests are finite. Ferreira (1994) and Rath–Guillemot (2004) were accessible by abstract only and remain originality risks.
title: Sharp three-erasure stability of a Nyquist-spiked cyclic harmonic frame
